name: small-business-manager
description: Offline-first Small Business Manager + Farming module for 2-5 business partners. Zero mandatory cost.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:domain && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @sbm/api && npm run build -w @sbm/web
scripts.test: npm run build:domain && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.api: npm run build:domain && npm run start -w @sbm/api
scripts.api:dev: npm run build:domain && npm run dev -w @sbm/api
scripts.web:dev: npm run build:domain && npm run dev -w @sbm/web
scripts.web:build: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @sbm/web
